title: The 1902 Nobel citation credits Ross with showing how malaria enters the body
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits Ronald Ross for work on malaria that showed how it enters the organism.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 1902 says Ronald Ross received the prize in physiology or medicine for his work on malaria, by which he showed how it enters the organism and thereby laid a foundation for research and for methods of combating it. The record dates the award 30 October 1902. Current case and death estimates are on the WHO malaria cards. This card is the 1902 citation.
